title: observability: token/KV cost & latency dashboards + alert tuning
author: Avery Chen
description: Motivation: operators and SRE need token-level visibility (cost + latency) and KV-cache hit profiling to understand unit economics and regression impacts. This PR adds curated Grafana dashboards, Prometheus recording rules, improved tracing spans for token-level operations, and alert tuning based on production noise analysis. Main goals: 1) expose per-route and per-model token cost/latency breakdowns, 2) include KV-cache hit/miss heatmaps and tail-latency distributions, 3) reduce alert noise by switching to ratio-based alerts and using short/long-window anomaly suppression, 4) provide playbook links and recommended pager thresholds. Changes: - New Grafana dashboard panels: Token Cost Breakdown, Token Latency P50/P95/P99, KV Cache Hit Ratio, KV Miss Latency, Per-route token spend, Model-version comparison. - Prometheus: recording rules for token_cost_per_request, token_latency_quantiles (p50/p95/p99), kv_cache_hit_ratio, kv_miss_latency_seconds_histogram_bucket conversion. - Alerting: tuned alerts for token_cost_increase_ratio (5m/1h windows), kv_cache_hit_ratio_drop (3sigma suppression), increased cooldown on token-latency p99 to avoid flapping during deploys. - Tracing: added tags and spans around KV cache lookup, cache fill, and token accounting; correlated span IDs with request_id for UI drilldown. - Logs: added structured log keys for token_cost_us, kv_hit=true/false to enable quick queries. - Docs: updated runbook (observability/runbooks/token_cost.md) and linked to Linear tickets and escalation steps. Checklist: - [x] Dashboards added and reviewed with SRE and Console team - [x] Recording rules validated in staging for 48h - [x] Alerts tuned and verified with simulated noise - [x] Tracing and logs instrumented and sampled in staging - [x] Runbook updated and PR linked to Linear ENG-1423 Backwards compatibility: non-breaking for metrics consumers, new labels added but existing metric names preserved where possible. Rollout plan: staged rollout: enable recording rules in staging -> enable in canary cluster for 24h -> full rollout with 1-hour ramp and monitor alert firing. Related: ENG-1380 (kv-cache improvements), PM-88 (dashboard redesign), SUP-4821 (customer incident RCA).
commits: Add Grafana dashboard JSON for token/KV cost-latency overview
Prometheus: add recording rules for token_cost and kv_cache metrics
Alerts: update alertmanager rules and silence windows
Tracing: instrument KV lookup/fill spans and correlate with request_id
review_comments: Diego Martinez: Overall looks good — only request is to avoid high-cardinality labels on token_cost metric. Can we collapse model_version into a label value map?

Avery Chen (reply): Reworked token_cost to keep model_version as label but limited to top-10 using label_replace in recording rule; added note to docs. See updated recording_rules/token_cost_rules.yaml

Priya Patel: Alert thresholds seem aggressive for small customers — recommend ratio-based alerting with a minimum baseline window. Also please add a mute during deploys — we have a deploy tag in tracing.
Avery Chen (reply): Implemented ratio-based alerting with 5m/1h comparison and added deploy_silence label to alerts; added playbook section for muting during deploys.
Evan Liu: Can you confirm SLO/alerts won't overlap causing double-paging? Suggest add annotation to link to SLOs.
Avery Chen (reply): Added annotation linking to SLOs and consolidated token-latency alerts to avoid duplicates.
QA: Verified dashboards render in staging and recording rules evaluated without errors after 48h run.
SRE approval: +1 after small tweaks; recommend a canary rollout for 24h before full rollout.

Updated runbook with playbook for alert triage and deploy mute procedures. Recommended SRE action: monitor new token_cost_increase_ratio alerts for one week.
